connection.s_credentials.title: PetKit account
connection.s_credentials.description: PetKit allows only one active session per account: signing in here signs the same account out of the PetKit phone app and Home Assistant. In the PetKit app, add a family member (share your devices with a second account) and use that account here, so your main account stays on your phone.
